name: 04d-version-migration
description: Migrates a Java project to a new language level and/or framework version in a sandbox copy: detects the baseline, reads the architecture out of the code knowledge graph, records the pre-migration behaviour, puts a migration plan in front of a human for approval, iterates build rounds until green on the target runtime, and renders docs/agent_output/04-remediation/migration_plan_<slug>.md and migration_<slug>.md plus a cumulative migration_<slug>.diff.
